decisions.reason: Removing the E/L selected development direction does not revoke or alter the established Hero V geometry; the project conclusion is already represented separately in this Requirement's lifecycle.
The source reports failure to preserve the second V and ends further revisions, but it does not replace or delete any current second-V construction rule.
The project conclusion does not revoke the selected Balanced Flow spacing or otherwise change the wordmark's kerning requirements.
The source confirms that the latest examples failed to preserve the locked hierarchy but does not change the hierarchy's required value.
The source does not discuss or alter the shared-baseline rule.
Concluding revisions does not revoke the previously selected Satin Reflection champagne-gold finish for the existing artwork.
The source does not replace or cancel the rule that the É accent literally derive from the Hero V terminal.
The project conclusion does not change the established peak-alignment requirement between the Hero V and É accent.
The source neither changes the all-caps treatment nor selects another case treatment.
The source does not revoke or alter the selected distribution of champagne gold across the signature elements.
The conclusion of design revisions and removal of the E/L development direction do not affect accepted review-image formats.
